name: Dataset composition and bounding-box definition audit v1
question: Can raw detections and publisher boxes be compared as the same annotated object extent before attributing lowIoU to missed cattle?

OpenCows_evidence.section: 3.1, page8 in PDF: torso annotation excluding head, neck, legs and tail
OpenCows_evidence.train_visual_samples: 6real+6synthetic, hash-rank prefix definition-audit-v1:, only existing train role. No validation/test image viewing or model selection.

Toros_evidence.publisher_description: COCO-pretrained YOLOv8 and DeepSORT initialisation plus manual box/ID correction. Page does not explicitly declare a torso-only extent.
Toros_evidence.scope: Six previously used publisher-derived events. Review actual boxes; do not assume all annotations follow a whole-animal extent from text alone.

geometry_descriptions.source: Existing frozen pre-tracker raw outputs for official, five-epoch and three20epoch models; no new inference
geometry_descriptions.best_candidate: For each clipped nonempty publisher row, highestIoU same-frame raw candidate; descriptive per-row matching, not one-to-one accuracy evaluation
geometry_descriptions.flag: A retained geometric candidate has intersection/prediction_area >=0.9, prediction/reference_area in[0.15,0.75], and IoU<0.5. This is a review flag, not a TP and not proof it covers the right torso.
geometry_descriptions.witness_selection: Per model, earliest flagged source frame then lowest publisher ID. No inference score or event-count tuning.
geometry_descriptions.no_score_change: All frozen event scores and original IoU diagnostic outputs retained. No shrinking reference boxes or relabeling them automatically.

training_decision: Do not start real/synthetic training ablation until box-definition comparability is reviewed. This stage prepares evidence and a corrected evaluation interpretation.
forbidden: No new cow identity labels, independent human ground truth, augmented mother-image linkage, causal synthetic-data claim or board performance assertion.
